findings.title: The 822 summary and reached-writer audit require an explicit WIA exclusion chain
evidence: The observed interval begins after turn-21 brigade-reinforcement and therefore includes turn-21 wia-trickleback.

src/sim/combat/militia_casualties.ts:134-142 makes militia combat the sole positive producer of pool wounded_pending; src/sim/formation_spawn.ts:985-1004 only converts that pending value back to available.

src/sim/combat/attack_resolution_osid.ts:1412-1427 emits defender_militia_pool_key on every canonical militia battle and src/scenario/scenario_runner.ts:3271-3308 forwards it into every retained weekly battle row.

The retained weekly ledger contains zero defender_militia_pool_key=pale:RS rows through turn 22; the canonical OSID resolver clears attack orders before the compatibility resolver at src/sim/combat/attack_resolution_osid.ts:1872 and src/sim/turn_phases/war_phases.ts:3004-3046.
findings.conclusion: Under the observed canonical OSID path, pale:RS wounded_pending remains zero through the disputed interval, so turn-21 WIA trickleback contributed zero. This closes the apparent contradiction in 822, but the assumption that the retained weekly OSID battle projection is complete for this run must remain stated.

findings.title: The final 822 synthesis is frozen but lacks a successful finalizer receipt
evidence: 822-pale-upstream-a receipt: child_exit=0, wrapper_exit=0, artifact contract pass; it produced the initial UNMEASURED result.
822-pale-upstream-b receipt: child_exit=1, wrapper_exit=126, failed takeover-displacement assertion, no result.json.
822-pale-upstream-c receipt: child_exit=1, wrapper_exit=126, failed phase-key assertion, no result.json.
The reviewed final result was written after those failed attempts and is not listed as an output of a successful preserved-preflight receipt.
findings.conclusion: Use the frozen hash as the identity of the reviewed synthesis and preserve all three actual receipts. Do not describe the final synthesis itself as receipt 0/0. This provenance gap does not overturn the source-and-retained-data exclusion chain, but it must remain visible.

findings.title: The actual positive writer phase is supported; the exact writer line is not
evidence: Direct retained receipts establish pale:RS available 0 at turn-21 regular close and 111 at turn-22 regular open, with committed unchanged at 1600 across the opening boundary.
Turn-21 strategic-reserve collection, turn-22 reconstitution, pool decay, formation spawn, and elective recruitment writes are nonpositive.
Turn-22 takeover arrival is 24 and the governing one-turn floor contribution is 0.
Pale has one authored OOB brigade and it is active in the initial save, excluding the pending-authored-brigade gates for mandatory accrual and reroute deficit credit.
The actual recruitment mode is player_choice, excluding the early-war pool-population tail.

After the WIA exclusion above, ongoing-mobilization is the sole surviving positive writer and therefore necessarily credited pale:RS; later decay may have reduced its gross credit to the observed 111.
findings.conclusion: Report ongoing-mobilization as the actual supported positive writer class by exclusive-path deduction. Keep direct-controller versus shared displaced-in credit, amounts, operands, and decay unmeasured.
